summary: Safehold Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a joint venture with a Brookfield affiliate on a portfolio of ground leases. Safehold contributed assets generating ~$14M annual ground rent; Brookfield will purchase a non-controlling 49% interest at a gross valuation of ~$348M. Safehold retains call options after year 7, maintains day-to-day control, and will consolidate the venture. Net proceeds will be used for debt repayment and general corporate purposes. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation is stated. The deal is a simple asset-level JV, not a change-of-control event. Watch for future exercise of call options or potential asset sales.
